What's new: update toast, side panel, unread dot on Settings and release history in About
changed: Playlist tracks shown as a table (title, album, duration), with search highlighting
Missing album names are filled in from Deezer

releases.summary: Playlist search and a customizable player bar.
added: Search tracks across all your playlists (Ctrl+F) or inside a single playlist
Player bar customization: transparent, blurred album cover or custom image/GIF background
Dim slider for the player bar background
Icon style selection for the player bar (filled, outlined, rounded, sharp)
fixed: Only one instance of Sona can run at a time; reopening it brings the existing window to the front

releases.summary: Playlist library and a floating player bar.
added: Playlist library: save multiple playlists, with favorites and source filters
Playlist detail page with sync and remove
Floating player bar with rounded corners
changed: Redesigned Playlist page (new colors and typography)
fixed: Now-playing highlight and prefetch are kept after syncing a playlist

added: Playlist import from public links (Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, Deezer)
Built-in player with shuffle, repeat, volume and wave seek bar
Album artwork for every track in the playlist
Discord Rich Presence (opt-in in Settings)
changed: Player and playlist error messages are now translated (IT/EN)
fixed: Browser extension and local WebSocket server for playlists

added: Detachable mini player mode (frameless, resizable, always-on-top window).
New modern modal settings card with Appearance, Background, Audio, and Window sections.
Accent color customization with curated color palette.
Official MIT License.
changed: Refactored UI layout: replaced legacy side panel with the new settings modal.
Simplified playback controls: removed unsupported shuffle and repeat buttons.
Optimized SeekBar wave rendering using RepaintBoundary to avoid background blur repaints.
Unified player volume API (per-app volume for Spotify).
fixed: Fixed detached mini player not closing and duplicating when reattaching to the main window.
Fixed auto-updater conflicts using Win32 named mutex and delayed detached installer launch.
Added `runZonedGuarded` startup error boundary to prevent launch failures on corrupted settings.
Added defensive clamping on volume sliders and safe enum bounds checking.
Fixed release script failure on Windows 11 when opening Notepad.

added: Add detachable mini player mode
Add accent color customization in a Personalization section
changed: Remove non-functional shuffle and repeat buttons

added: Three disc styles: classic vinyl, full album, and animated pulse
Custom image or GIF in place of the album artwork
Per-app volume control for Spotify
Settings persist across restarts
changed: Removed external plugins (native Win32 + dart:io), fixing a build failure
